title: Harder Totems
description: Makes Totems of Undying 2.5x harder to obtain.
body:
Vanilla **Totems of Undying** are incredibly powerful, yet obtaining them often boils down to creating a simple raid farm *et voila!* infinite lives.
**Harder Totems** completely reimagines this progression loop, transforming totems from cheap, farmable commodities into rewarding, multi-tiered artifacts that require actual effort, crafting, and ritual to create. ## Key Features ### Evoker (Re)Balancing Where right now (in vanilla) the Evoker drops the totem immediately, using this mod the Evoker drops their **Accursed Emerald**, a manifestation of their power. You need to cure **2** of these to make the eyes of a totem giving it some of its magic.
The Evoker's dark curses can only be exhausted from magic of your own in an **Enchanting Table**. ### Interactive In-World Carving: Instead of simply placing recipes in the basic crafting grid, you are able to interact and carve your plate into a totem directly in the world environment using your off-hand.
This has a unique animation displaying the progress of carving eventually rotating to reveal the item much like the vanilla totem pop animation. ### Netherite Totem of Undying: A new more powerful tier of totem allowing you to cheat death **3 times** before it breaks.
Using the advanced metal you can extend the cured emeralds power: for the price of 2 standard totems you create the equivalent of 3 while being contained to 1 slot. ### New Advancements: Branching from the **monsters hunted** achievement a new achievement tree is visible allowing for easier information in how to progress while also relocating vanilla advancements to match the new Pillager advancement tree. ## Fully Configurable Harder Totems allow the user to pick how modded the game feels natively in [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (some changes require either the world to be restarted or to use the /reload command) ### Carving Mode If you aren't a fan of having to spend time manually using your shears fo carve the gold and netherite plates you can disable it in favour of using a crafting grid for instant conversion - it does still drain durability though. ### Netherite Totems If you only wanted to have a simple mod to change how totems are obtained this is best for you. This setting can be disabled to completely block any netherite totem-related items being crafted. ### EMI There are a few options available for EMI if downloaded to make the information easier on the eyes.
